Captures a perf flamegraph for selected tiles or the Agave process.

# Purpose
This file defines the `flame` action for a Firedancer command-line tool. It adds a diagnostic command that uses `/usr/bin/perf` to capture CPU samples from one tile, one tile kind, all tiles, or the Agave process. The command checks permissions in `flame_cmd_perm`, parses the target in [`flame_cmd_args`](<#flame_cmd_args>), and then runs the main workflow in [`flame_cmd_fn`](<#flame_cmd_fn>).

The main function joins the shared topology in read-only mode, finds the target tile or process, and builds a thread or process list for `perf record`. It installs signal handlers so `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM` stop the `perf` child process, then forks and execs `perf record -g -F 99` to collect samples. After collection ends, it runs `perf script report flamegraph` to print the flamegraph report. The file ends by exporting the `fd_action_flame` action descriptor, which makes this command available to the action framework.
